actions.action: Move the plant to an area with a more suitable temperature, away from windows or vents
Give the plant a light Vitamin B1 solution
Repot the plant (dividing and cutting roots if needed), then water thoroughly
Check soil moisture with a finger to the first knuckle before watering
Water to keep the soil evenly moist but not soggy
Make sure the pot has drainage holes
Cut off damaged leaves if needed

verdict.reason: The answer mainly blames shock from heat or a move and mentions underwatering only as one possibility; its moist-soil, misting and give-it-time advice is buried among repotting and B1 suggestions, but with soil checks it is not likely to harm the plant.
